title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-02-14

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an early‑68 smoking show, highlighted by Jerry’s soaring guitar and a heartfelt second‑set dedication to Neal Cassady.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a vast improvement over earlier releases, delivering crisp, high‑fidelity soundboard quality. The performance itself is described as “stunning” and “smoking,” with the band delivering a powerful early‑68 set that includes several first‑time song performances and a moving dedication to Neal Cassady.

ai_rating.rationale: All detailed reviews (4 out of 5) give 5‑star ratings, praising both the musical performance and the audio quality; only one review comments on access issues but does not criticize the show or recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note a “vast improvement” over previous releases and describe the audio as crisp with no reported drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑68 second Carousel show featuring first performances of several songs; the band dedicates the second set to Neal Cassady, giving the concert an emotional arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry’s guitar work is highlighted as “wow fucking cool man” with his tone and stage presence praised.
